items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then confirmed ACTIVE for Week 7 vs Raiders after calf issue; prior QUESTIONABLE with optimism from reports.
items.why: ETR summary and corroboration; Schefter/Rapoport/Berry confirmed active.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; reverse any prior beneficiary starts.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets as primary option with Adams out longer-term.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then inactive Week 7 after quad strain; Rapoport noted unlikely and not full participant.
items.why: ETR pregame summary; Schefter listed inactive; Rapoport sources said unlikely.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for Jets backup RBs.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT Week 7 vs Bengals with high-ankle sprain; third straight miss, was QUESTIONABLE earlier.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Schefter/Rapoport confirmed downgrade and Huntley start; close for next week per Rapoport.
items.implication: Snoop Huntley starts; Ravens pass game limited.
items.opportunity: Slight bump to Ravens skill if any volume, but overall downgrade.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; JK Dobbins only 21% snaps. Berry LOVE/upgrade, roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: Berry per-player: led shares post-return; prior preseason call validated; Dobbins down.

items.text: Seahawks/Broncos/Vikings/Packers potential suitors for Jonathan Taylor per Schefter trade deadline watch; Jadarian Price (chest) practice window opening Week 8 eligible, unsure status.
items.why: Levitan on Schefter names; Rapoport/Schefter confirm Price window open by Macdonald.
items.implication: JT trade could open Indy RB; Price return adds SEA RB depth beyond JSN.
items.opportunity: If JT moves, handcuffs rise; Price could share or lead SEA carries.

items.text: Cam Skattebo hamstring injury late; Levitan thinks actually hurt but not certain; ETR watching with Tracy.
items.why: Levitan: think actually hurt, not certain; was lead expected pregame per Rapoport.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible limited or backup elevated next.
items.opportunity: If out, Tracy or others get carries.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide but almost certainly fine per Levitan; ETR watching post-game.
items.why: Levitan direct: almost certainly fine despite slide; would be tilting if serious.
items.implication: No major concern for next week; continue as RB1.

items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) both OUT for Eagles Week 7/MNF; Saquon expected to play.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Rapoport notes on activations of other TEs; Saquon EXPECTED.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thin; more targets to remaining options and TEs.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Goedert, other WRs; Saquon full role if active.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play Week 7 for Packers after prior absence.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter activations expected to play.
items.implication: Resumes lead back role; handcuffs down.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY Week 7/MNF despite hamstring Q listing.
items.why: ETR explicit EXPECTED; Rapoport context pregame.
items.implication: Full or near-full role vs DAL.

items.text: Texans WR routes: Nico Collins 24 lead on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return (first since 2024); Noel left early turf toe.
items.why: Levitan post-game route counts; Dell limited in return.
items.implication: Collins clear alpha; Dell not immediate full role.
items.opportunity: Collins high route/target share; Dell handcuff/monitor.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant, day-to-day per source.
items.implication: Likely plays next; monitor but low concern.
items.opportunity: If misses, Mason or others elevated (Mason was IN).

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game without Rice); high volume but Levitan notes never topped 83 rec yards in 37 games.
items.why: Levitan route data + ceiling caveat post-Rice absence.
items.implication: Volume there but efficiency/ceiling capped historically; monitor if breaks out.
items.opportunity: Primary WR routes with Rice out; targets available.
items.conflict: High opportunity vs historical low ceiling.

items.text: Jets WR routes with AD Mitchell back: Garrett Wilson 29, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgt season), Mitchell 18 on 33 dropbacks.
items.why: Levitan route data + Cooper efficiency note.
items.implication: Wilson primary; Cooper emerging efficient option.
items.opportunity: Wilson high routes; Cooper target efficiency upside.
